blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — National ID services will be available 24/7 at the Cebu City 24/7 Government Services Hub from Sept. 21 to 26, 2026, as the Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Cebu Provincial Statistical Office deploys an additional overnight shift.
